info.name: Palo Alto Networks Prisma SD-WAN API
info.description:
REST API for the Prisma SD-WAN branch networking platform providing programmatic access to site management, WAN and LAN interface configuration, QoS rules, path policy rules, site performance metrics, application usage monitoring, and alarm management. Prisma SD-WAN enables intelligent path selection, application-aware routing, and centralized management of branch office connectivity across the SASE fabric. The unified API is available at https://api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com. A legacy CloudGenix-compatible API is available at https://api.cloudgenix.com/v4.7.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
